Far below the standards and level of service advertised...
Sep 2026 • Couples
I chose Lai to celebrate my partner’s birthday and booked a private room to make the evening special. The food was generally good, and I want to make that clear. Unfortunately, the rest of the experience fell far below what should be expected from an establishment of this standard.

We spent nearly 2.5 hours there, with a lot of waiting and extremely basic service that, at times, felt frankly amateurish. The waiter repeatedly approached us at inappropriate moments, even asking whether we wanted to order dessert while we had not even finished our main courses.

When making the reservation, I had already agreed to the VND 3,000,000 minimum spend for the private room. Yet during dinner, the waiter came to tell me in front of my partner that we had not ordered enough yet. For a birthday evening organized for her, involving her in the financial side of the arrangement was completely unnecessary. He could simply have spoken to me discreetly away from the table. At this level, such a lack of tact and discretion is difficult to understand.

I had also paid VND 700,000 for flowers. I acknowledge that I did not explicitly ask for them to be placed on the table, but from an establishment of this standard, I expected at least some initiative, or simply for someone to ask me how I wanted them to be presented.

In the end, I had to ask for the flowers myself, and when they were finally brought to me, the order label was still attached to the bouquet. They also did not seem particularly fresh to us.

The most disappointing part, however, was the birthday cake.

The day before, Lai had proactively offered me a small cake, including photos showing how it was supposed to be presented. I agreed to this in writing. Yet during dinner, nothing happened. I had to remind the staff myself of what had been agreed.

When the cake finally arrived, it was very different from what had been presented to me. More importantly, the waiter explained directly to my partner that, according to the chef, it was now too late to prepare the cake properly and that it was essentially intended for presentation rather than for eating.

We tasted it: it was completely unsuccessful and, in our opinion, simply inedible. The restaurant later acknowledged in writing that the cake had not been prepared and presented as agreed.

Despite all of this, I did not immediately post a negative review. I chose to contact Lai privately first and gave them several opportunities to resolve the situation.

The only compensation offered was a VND 210,000 refund for the flowers or a 15% discount on a future visit. Despite this, I continued to favor dialogue rather than making the matter public.

The manager eventually contacted my partner, maintained the same offer, and assured her that he would get back to her within 48 hours.

Around ten days later, we still have not received any response.

Ultimately, it was the way the situation was handled afterward that convinced me to share our experience publicly. Mistakes can happen. But such an accumulation of shortcomings, followed by a poorly handled complaint and then a commitment made by the manager himself that was not honored, is much harder to accept.

At this price point and level of positioning, serving good food is simply not enough. Service, discretion, attention to detail, and consideration for the guest are also essential parts of the experience.

Unfortunately, in all of these areas, Lai deeply disappointed us.

Vietnam-HCM LAI Experience
Jun 2026 • Solo
Overall, considering the food, service, and ambiance, I would rate my experience 7.5/10. I was a bit disappointed because I expected the dish I received to be the same one I had booked, but it turned out to be different. The staff explained that the menu changes from time to time, which I wish had been communicated in advance.

That said, the service made up for it. Câm Dung was attentive throughout my visit, and I also appreciated the staff member who mistakenly served me the wrong coffee but immediately offered to replace it. Their hospitality and willingness to accommodate guests were truly commendable.
